pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which greeting is the polite way to say hello to a teacher? (1 mark)
   A. 再见 zàijiàn
   B. 您好 nín hǎo
   C. 我叫 wǒ jiào
   D. 谢谢 xièxie

2. What does 和 (hé) mean? (1 mark)
   A. That
   B. Father
   C. Mother
   D. And

3. Which Chinese word means "younger brother"? (1 mark)
   A. 妈妈 māma
   B. 弟弟 dìdi
   C. 哥哥 gēge
   D. 有 yǒu

4. What does 椅子 (yǐzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. House
   C. In front of
   D. Left side

5. What does 猫 (māo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Cat
   C. Window
   D. Is at, is in

6. What does 星期一到星期五,我上学 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I go to school on Saturday
   B. From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   C. Monday is a holiday
   D. On Sunday, I rest at home

7. In the Chinese week, which day is 星期一? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Monday

8. Which Chinese word means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 肉 ròu
   C. 吃 chī
   D. 饼 bǐng

9. Fill the blank: 我____米饭。 (I eat rice.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 听
   C. 喝
   D. 吃

10. Which food group does 菠菜 belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Drinks
   C. Fruits
   D. Meat

11. Which sentence means "The wind is very strong."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 太阳很大。
   D. 风很大。

12. What does 沙发在门旁边 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is beside the door
   B. The sofa is in the garden
   C. The sofa is under the door
   D. The door is in the sofa

13. Fill the blank: 这是____? (Who is this?) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 谁
   C. 几
   D. 哪儿

14. What does the small mark 、 do in a list? (1 mark)
   A. It ends a sentence
   B. It shows a tone
   C. It asks a question
   D. It separates items in the list

15. Which Chinese word means "things"? (1 mark)
   A. 厕所 cèsuǒ
   B. 前面 qiánmiàn
   C. 东西 dōngxi
   D. 花园 huāyuán

16. Why should you not shout when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting is quiet
   B. Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   C. Shouting is polite
   D. Shouting makes tones clearer

17. Which word comes first in pinyin alphabetical order? (1 mark)
   A. xiāngjiāo
   B. bǐng
   C. chá
   D. mángguǒ

18. What does 牛奶 niúnǎi mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. Chicken
   C. Beef
   D. Tea

19. Fill the blank: 窗户在门____。 (The window is above the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 下面
   C. 上面
   D. 旁边

20. In the character 人, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 捺 nà

21. In 十, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. The horizontal 横
   B. Both together
   C. The vertical 竖
   D. Neither

22. Fill the blank: 我家有五____人。 (There are five people in my family.) (1 mark)
   A. 号
   B. 两
   C. 口
   D. 只

23. Which sentence means "This is my mother."? (1 mark)
   A. 我爱你。
   B. 这是我姐姐。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 这是我妈妈。

24. What does 弟弟 (dìdi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who
   B. Younger brother
   C. Younger sister
   D. Older sister

25. How many strokes does 上 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 2
   C. 4
   D. 3

26. Which sentence means "Tomorrow is Thursday."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天星期三。
   B. 明天是星期四。
   C. 星期五,去清真寺。
   D. 我星期三去学校。

27. Which Chinese word means "Saturday"? (1 mark)
   A. 八 bā
   B. 六 liù
   C. 休息 xiūxi
   D. 星期六 xīngqīliù

28. What does 刀 (dāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Month
   C. Knife
   D. To give (a gift)

29. Which sentence means "The rain is heavy."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 风很小。
   C. 今天天气很好。
   D. 雨很大。

30. Which sentence means "The sun is very big."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 太阳很大。
   D. 雨很大。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá. (2 marks)

32. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

33. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house." (3 marks)

34. Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin. (4 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday." (3 marks)

36. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table." (4 marks)

37. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!" (2 marks)

38. Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them. (4 marks)

39. Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐. (3 marks)

40. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" and "Hello! (polite)" (4 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 礼物 and 冰箱. (2 marks)

42. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ. (2 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." (2 marks)

44. Give two habits for keeping your body clean. (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family." (3 marks)

46. Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly. (3 marks)

47. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息. (2 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 您好 nín hǎo
   您 is the polite form of you.

2. D — And
   和 (hé) means and.

3. B — 弟弟 dìdi
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

4. A — Chair
   椅子 (yǐzi) means chair.

5. B — Cat
   猫 (māo) means cat.

6. B — From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   到 is to, and 上学 is go to school.

7. D — Monday
   Chinese counts the days from Monday.

8. B — 肉 ròu
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

9. D — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

10. A — Vegetables
   菠菜 is spinach.

11. D — 风很大。
   风很大。 (fēng hěn dà.) means "The wind is very strong.".

12. A — The sofa is beside the door
   旁边 is beside.

13. B — 谁
   谁 means who.

14. D — It separates items in the list
   、 is the list comma.

15. C — 东西 dōngxi
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

16. B — Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   Use projection, not shouting.

17. B — bǐng
   b comes before c, m and x.

18. A — Milk
   牛奶 is milk; 牛肉 is beef.

19. C — 上面
   上面 is above.

20. C — 撇 piě
   撇 before 捺.

21. A — The horizontal 横
   Horizontal comes before vertical when they cross.

22. C — 口
   口 is used to count family members.

23. D — 这是我妈妈。
   这是我妈妈。 (zhè shì wǒ māma.) means "This is my mother.".

24. B — Younger brother
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

25. D — 3
   上 has three strokes.

26. B — 明天是星期四。
   明天是星期四。 (míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.) means "Tomorrow is Thursday.".

27. D — 星期六 xīngqīliù
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

28. C — Knife
   刀 (dāo) means knife.

29. D — 雨很大。
   雨很大。 (yǔ hěn dà.) means "The rain is heavy.".

30. C — 太阳很大。
   太阳很大。 (tàiyáng hěn dà.) means "The sun is very big.".

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like to drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b, 1 mark for p, 1 mark for another pair, 1 mark for the paper test or description.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo! 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: I love you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
